fed-cca-clean-energy-equipment.note: Tax deduction (accelerated depreciation) for taxable businesses that buy eligible Class 43.1/43.2 equipment.

fed-cca-zero-emission-vehicles.note: Tax deduction (accelerated depreciation) for taxable businesses buying zero-emission vehicles or equipment.

fed-aafc-agriscience-projects.note: Must be incorporated with 2 years of audited statements (newer firms contact the program); academics cannot apply directly.

fed-dfo-atlantic-fisheries-fund.note: Must be active in or support fish harvesting, processing or aquaculture.

fed-bdc-advisory-services.note: Paid consulting service; BDC can finance the cost.

fed-biofuels-production-incentive.note: Must already produce biodiesel or renewable diesel eligible for Clean Fuels Regulations credits.

fed-build-canada-apprenticeship-service.note: For small and medium employers hiring a first-year Red Seal apprentice; not yet open.

fed-acoa-business-development-program.note: Talk to your nearest ACOA office before applying.

fed-ced-business-scale-up-productivity.note: Retail, restaurants, transportation services, housing construction, daycares, salons and bars are ineligible.

fed-canada-growth-fund.note: Commercial investor for large decarbonization projects and scaling clean-tech firms, not a grant.

fed-pch-canada-periodical-fund-aid-to-pu.note: Must be majority Canadian-owned and have published an eligible periodical for a full 12-month cycle.

fed-cavco-canadian-film-video-production.note: Applicant must be a Canadian-controlled taxable Canadian corporation primarily in film/video production.

fed-clean-fuels-fund.note: Capital projects need large minimum fuel production capacity; call is closed.

fed-community-futures.note: Serves rural and remote areas; loan limits and criteria set by each local office.

fed-pch-creative-export-canada.note: Must be incorporated and Canadian-owned; Export Development stream limited to revenue of $10M or less.

fed-edc-export-guarantee-program.note: Requires international sales and a lender; suited to complex export financing.

fed-cavco-film-video-production-services.note: Applicant must be a taxable Canadian or foreign-owned corporation primarily in film/video production.

fed-green-freight-program.note: Must operate heavy-duty vehicles (Class 2B-8); Stream 1 intake closed January 16, 2026.

fed-cannor-ideanorth.note: Contact CanNor (Operations@cannor.gc.ca) for funding terms and intake timing.

fed-nrcan-indigenous-natural-resource-pa.note: For-profits must be 50%+ controlled by Indigenous communities; individually owned businesses are not funded.

fed-ced-montreal-east-end-initiative.note: Project must be in Montreal's East End (east of Avenue Papineau); local-reach SMEs only exceptionally.

fed-ideas-competitive-projects.note: Funding only through periodic defence and security challenge calls.

fed-pacifican-lytton-business-restart.note: Only for businesses new or returning to Lytton, B.C.

fed-mitacs-accelerate.note: Requires a university supervisor and intern; for-profit partners must pay their share with private funds.

fed-ngen-project-funding.note: Collaborative projects through NGen calls; NGen membership appears required.

fed-nserc-applied-research-development.note: A college applies; businesses join as partners and contribute cash of at least 25% of the grant.

fed-aafc-poultry-egg-on-farm-investment.note: Only supply-managed poultry and egg producers holding quota on January 1, 2021.

fed-ced-quebec-economic-development-prog.note: Projects must benefit many users (mainly businesses or tourists) and match a regional priority.

fed-acoa-raii.note: Minimum contribution request $1M (proj_min derived); AI must be central; call closes Nov 20, 2026.

fed-ced-raii.note: AI must be central; retail, food services, transportation, construction, daycare and salons excluded.

fed-cannor-raii.note: Contact CanNor for amounts and cost share; for projects starting in 2026-27.

fed-acoa-regi-business-scale-up-producti.note: Talk to your nearest ACOA office before applying.

fed-sreps.note: For utilities and Indigenous-led clean electricity projects; no stream accepting proposals.

fed-csa-stdp.note: Funding only through periodic Announcements of Opportunity for space technology.

fed-student-work-placement-program.note: Apply through one of 18 delivery partners; criteria vary by partner.

fed-telefilm-development-program.note: Must be a Canadian-controlled corporation; producer track record required by stream.

fed-telefilm-marketing-program.note: Must be a Canadian-controlled distribution or production corporation that is financially stable.

fed-telefilm-production-program.note: Must be a Canadian-controlled corporation; project budget at least $250,000 and CAVCO-certifiable.

fed-trade-commissioner-service.note: Needs a realistic international business plan; one-person unregistered businesses are not served.

fed-wah-ila-toos-northern-reache.note: Projects must serve Northern communities; Indigenous-led projects prioritized.

fed-aafc-youth-employment-skills-program.note: Must be an agriculture or agri-food employer hiring a youth aged 15-30 on payroll.

fed-zevip.note: Applicant must be a legal entity; small projects go through delivery organizations, private projects over $20M to the Canada Infrastructure Bank.

ab-aioc-loan-guarantee.note: Only Indigenous Nations/groups and Nation- or community-owned entities; privately owned Indigenous businesses are not eligible.

ab-era-agriculture-water-land-challenge.note: Derived: minimum $250,000 ERA request with at least 1:1 private match; project must be piloted or deployed in Alberta.

ab-alberta-made-screen-industries-progra.note: Production Grant covers 25% of eligible Alberta costs (plus up to 7% for training); productions spending $500,000+ use the tax credit instead.

ab-petrochemicals-incentive-program.note: Projects of $50M-$150M had to be operational by about Oct 30, 2025; larger projects by about Oct 2030.

ab-canada-alberta-job-grant.note: Employer must be registered and operating in Alberta at least one year; apply before training starts.

ab-scap-emerging-opportunities.note: Processors need a minimum $2M total project investment; primary producers are not eligible. Non-capital costs are 50%.

ab-innovation-employment-grant.note: Expenses must qualify for federal SR&ED; phases out at $10M-$50M taxable capital.

ab-era-methane-reduction-deployment.note: For upstream and midstream oil and gas facility owners/operators in Alberta; max $2M per parent company.

ab-scap-on-farm-efficiency.note: Primary producers with $25,000+ annual farm commodity production and a current Environmental Farm Plan.

ab-scap-on-farm-value-added.note: Primary producers with $25,000+ annual production adding value after harvest; non-capital costs are 50%.

ab-scap-resiliency-public-trust.note: The only businesses named as eligible are provincially licensed meat and dairy facilities; otherwise non-profits and public bodies.

ab-era-semi.note: Industrial facilities in eligible NAICS sectors; must complete a Facility Readiness Assessment first; new participants join a waitlist.

ab-scap-water-program.note: Primary producers with $25,000+ annual farm commodity production; land-only landlords excluded.

bc-hydro-business-energy-saving-incentiv.note: For BC Hydro commercial and small industrial sites; contractor must be a registered Alliance of Energy Professionals member.

bc-beneficial-management-practices.note: Needs a GST/CRA business number, B.C. farm income tax filing and a valid Environmental Farm Plan (most categories).

bc-book-publishing-tax-credit.note: Canadian-controlled book publisher receiving Canada Book Fund Support for Publishers base contributions.

bc-clean-buildings-tax-credit.note: Expenditures had to be paid by March 31, 2026; tax-exempt entities are not eligible.

bc-clean-industry-fund.note: Lead applicant must be an operation regulated under B.C.'s Output-Based Pricing System.

bc-enhanced-replant-program.note: Existing tree fruit, wine grape or berry producers only; one ERP application per farm per fiscal year.

bc-film-television-tax-credit.note: Production must meet Canadian content rules and get an eligibility certificate from Creative BC.

bc-food-safety-program.note: Aquaculture/seafood, retail, restaurants, pet food and supplement operations are excluded.

bc-fortisbc-commercial-energy-assessment.note: FortisBC commercial customers (owner or long-term leaseholder) with a medium-sized business or small industrial facility.

bc-fortisbc-custom-efficiency-program.note: Project must save at least 1,000 GJ gas or 50,000 kWh per year; written pre-approval required.

bc-go-electric-fleet-charging.note: Needs a fleet registered in B.C.; home-based businesses are not eligible.

bc-go-electric-commercial-vehicle-rebate.note: Rebate is per vehicle (up to 5 per year for businesses); intake reopens December 10, 2026.

bc-innovator-skills-initiative.note: Needs 5+ full-time employees, or recent growth, or outside investment; hire must be from an under-represented group.

bc-innovate-bc-integrated-marketplace.note: Lead applicant is a Solution Adopter in an approved testbed; B.C. tech firms take part as Solution Providers.

bc-interactive-digital-media-tax-credit.note: Needs $100,000+ eligible B.C. salaries if IDM is the principal business ($2M+ otherwise).

bc-mining-exploration-tax-credit.note: Corporations only (individuals use the separate personal credit); limited partners not eligible.

bc-creative-bc-passport-to-markets.note: Apply in the window for each designated market, before attending.

bc-production-services-tax-credit.note: Production must be accredited by Creative BC; accreditation fee $19,000.

bc-shipbuilding-ship-repair-tax-credit.note: Employer's principal business must be building, repairing or converting sea-going ships.

bc-traceability-adoption-program.note: Businesses need a 9-digit CRA business number and must file B.C. taxes; restaurants, pet food and supplements excluded.

bc-training-tax-credit-employers.note: For employers of apprentices registered with SkilledTradesBC; tax-exempt corporations excluded.

bc-workbc-wage-subsidy.note: New hire must be a WorkBC client; needs an active WorkSafeBC account; public sector excluded.

mb-scap-agri-processing-productivity-imp.note: Eligible project costs must be $10,000 to $50,000; equipment and software only.

mb-mfm-music-build-program.note: Manitoba-owned music companies; Level 2 ($20,000) needs 2 years registered and 2+ Manitoba artists.

mb-efficiency-mb-business-lighting.note: Supplier must be registered with Efficiency Manitoba; approval needed before purchase.

mb-cedf-business-loans.note: Business must operate north of Manitoba's 21st township, or be an Indigenous entity outside Winnipeg.

mb-efficiency-mb-commercial-energy-audit.note: Building owner must be a Manitoba Hydro commercial-rate customer; auditor must be pre-qualified.

mb-cultural-industries-printing-tax-cred.note: Book-printing division wages only; publisher must be unrelated and revenue per title capped at $200,000.

mb-efficiency-mb-custom-energy-solutions.note: Pre-approval required; incentive capped at 50% of incremental cost or one-year payback.

mb-green-energy-equipment-tax-credit.note: Rate depends on equipment (geothermal 7.5-15%, solar thermal 10%, biomass 15% for business use).

mb-efficiency-mb-innovation-fund.note: Expression of Interest first; needs a measurement plan and a secured demonstration site.

mb-book-publishing-tax-credit.note: Must be primarily a book publisher with at least two recent qualifying Canadian-authored books.

mb-film-video-production-tax-credit.note: Eligible production corporation certified by Manitoba Film & Music; 45% of salaries or 30% of production costs.

mb-interactive-digital-media-tax-credit.note: Apply for a Certificate of Eligibility before project work begins.

mb-manitoba-works-capital-incentive.note: Applicant must own the property and pay its taxes; 65% of costs from private sources and 10+ jobs.

mb-scap-market-development.note: Intake currently closed; watch for the next Sustainable CAP intake.

mb-paid-work-experience-tax-credits.note: Per-trainee caps ($5,000 per apprentice per year; $2,500 per co-op graduate per year); provincial Crown entities ineligible.

mb-efficiency-mb-small-business-program.note: Facility under 15,000 sq. ft., not a national franchise or chain, 10 or fewer Manitoba locations.

mb-trade-growth-investment-financing.note: Must be a CCPC or Manitoba co-op; proj_min derived from $250,000 minimum loan at up to 25% of project cost; apply before starting.

nb-scap-advancing-agri-food-processing.note: 30-50% for primary producers, up to 25% for processors not in primary agriculture; restaurants, grocery and retail food services ineligible.

nb-scap-beneficial-management-practices.note: NB farm owners/operators with an approved Environmental Farm Plan action plan updated within 5 years.

nb-nbif-breakthru.note: 2027 cohort applications closed; awards subject to NBIF due diligence.

nb-scap-business-planning-skills.note: Training up to 70% (max $3,000/project), business planning up to 60% (max $10,000/applicant).

nb-saveenergynb-business-rebate-program.note: Pre-approval required before starting work; lighting rebates available until January 31, 2027.

nb-saveenergynb-commercial-buildings-ret.note: Audit refunded up to 100% only if upgrades are done; upgrades paid $120/GJ (electric) or 25% (non-electric).

nb-scap-crop-livestock-sector-developmen.note: Machinery co-op element needs 4+ members under the Co-operative Associations Act (30%, max $30,000/yr).

nb-scap-enabling-agricultural-research-i.note: Projects must be science-based; up to 100% only for sector-wide benefit.

nb-saveenergynb-fuel-savings-transportat.note: Commercial transportation businesses only; devices must be bought and installed in NB.

nb-saveenergynb-industrial-energy-effici.note: Industrial facilities only; project must be pre-approved by NB Power before work starts.

nb-scap-market-development-access.note: Restaurants, caterers and other food service enterprises are excluded.

nb-nbif-venture-capital.note: Tech startup headquartered in NB in a government priority sector, with global scale plans.

nb-small-business-investor-tax-credit.note: Business must issue shares (private company, co-op or CEDC), net tangible assets under $50M, 75% of wages to NB residents.

nb-saveenergynb-new-construction-ci.note: Building must still be in planning/design; register before construction.

nb-saveenergynb-peak-rebate.note: Must be able to cut at least 100 kW per winter peak event.

nb-scap-risk-management-food-safety.note: 50% for one producer, 70% for two or more, up to 100% for associations; 40% for risk planning.

nl-scap-agriculture-growth-secondary-pro.note: Existing producers need $15,000+ annual farm sales (new entrants exempt path); program now fully committed.

nl-scap-agriculture-marketing.note: Existing producers need $15,000+ annual farm sales (new entrants exempt path); program now fully committed.

nl-scap-agriculture-research.note: Existing producers need $15,000+ annual farm sales (new entrants exempt path); program now fully committed.

nl-apprenticeship-wage-subsidy.note: 75% of apprentice wage up to $14/hour; needs MOU confirming a journeyperson on site.

nl-business-growth-program.note: Co-ops and non-profits must earn commercial revenue or pursue trade/economic development.

nl-scap-environmental-sustainability-cli.note: Existing producers need $15,000+ annual farm sales (new entrants exempt path); RALP has own intakes; non-RALP funds fully committed.

nl-harvester-enterprise-loan-program.note: Independent fish harvesters only; down payment typically 10% (vessels) or 15% (other).

nl-investment-attraction-fund.note: Inward/foreign direct investment projects that would not proceed without the funding.

nl-job-accelerator-growth-program.note: Must commit to 20+ new FTE jobs averaging $50,000 salary within three years; retail, wholesale, real estate excluded.

nl-jobsnl-wage-subsidy.note: Hire must happen after approval; 60% of wages up to $12/hour.

nl-scap-mitigating-agricultural-risks.note: Existing producers need $15,000+ annual farm sales (new entrants exempt path); program now fully committed.

nl-takecharge-business-efficiency-custom.note: Contact takeCHARGE and get project approval before starting; $0.10/kWh first-year savings, max $100,000.

nl-takecharge-business-product-rebates.note: Rebate criteria and amounts are set per product; municipalities have also claimed rebates.

nt-sustainable-cap-agri-food.note: Commercial stream needs 1 year operating in NWT and $10,000+ farm/business income; new entrants have a separate $30,000 stream.

nt-aea-renewable-energy-rebate.note: Pre-approval required; contact AEA before applying; project must finish within 4 months.

nt-film-rebate-program.note: Minimum anticipated NWT spend of $100,000; contact the NWT Film Commission first.

nt-prosper-nwt-northern-ai-adoption.note: Part 1 training and readiness assessment fully funded (business pays GST); Part 2 implementation funding optional.

nt-prosper-nwt-business-loans.note: Loans of $2M-$5M limited to key sectors such as housing, infrastructure, critical minerals or emerging technologies.

nt-prosper-nwt-venture-investment.note: Amounts above $2M subject to extra criteria and priority sectors.

nt-seed-entrepreneur-support.note: Applicant equity 30% in Yellowknife, Hay River, Fort Smith, Inuvik (20% elsewhere); talk to a regional Economic Development Officer first; arts and film no longer funded.

nt-seed-micro-business.note: Applicant equity 30% in Group 1 communities (20% elsewhere), sweat equity sometimes accepted; arts and film no longer funded.

nt-seed-capital-expansion-incentive.note: Offsets interest on loans for new capital; only Minister-designated sectors (agriculture, energy, fishing, knowledge economy, tourism, value-added manufacturing).

nt-seed-strategic-investments.note: Applicant equity 30% in Group 1 communities (20% elsewhere); project must leverage non-GNWT funding.

nt-trades-occupation-wage-subsidy.note: Up to $9/hour (derived max 3,200 h x $9; $16/hour for women in non-traditional trades) for registered NWT apprentices or occupation trainees.

nt-wage-subsidy-program.note: Employer pays at least 20% of wages; apply within 3 months of the hire's start date via an ECE Regional Service Centre.

ns-advancing-clean-technologies.note: Final intake closed; farms/agri-businesses need $30,000+ eligible income; projects under $60,000 (except three-phase power) go to Efficiency Nova Scotia.

ns-scap-agricultural-research-innovation.note: On-farm stream for farms and industry associations; research stream for institutions, associations and government bodies.

ns-ens-agriculture-bmp.note: Registered Nova Scotia farms (applicant 19+); Call #4 closed, no future call announced.

ns-ens-business-energy-rebates.note: Pre-approval needed for rebates over $15,000 and for data centre, water heating and solar measures.

ns-co-op-education-incentive.note: $8/hour up to 640 hours per co-op student (derived $5,120); wage must be at least $19.50/hour; provincial government entities ineligible.

ns-ens-commercial-new-construction.note: Design-stage buildings of at least 15,000 sq ft targeting 40% better than code; must work with an approved energy modeller.

ns-ens-custom-energy-retrofits.note: Electricity-saving retrofits only, simple payback before incentives of 1-15 years; agreement must be signed before buying equipment.

ns-digital-animation-tax-credit.note: Part A application required before principal photography or key animation.

ns-digital-media-tax-credit.note: Taxable Canadian corporation with a permanent establishment in Nova Scotia; credit is lesser of 50% of qualifying or 25% of total spend.

ns-scap-environmental-stewardship-climat.note: Farms need $30,000+ eligible gross commodity income (Mi'kmaq farming and community pastures follow separate criteria).

ns-export-development-program.note: Excludes franchisees, tourism operators, associations, most retailers/wholesalers and non-revenue-generating non-profits; minimum project $500 (Stream 1) or $3,000 (Stream 2).

ns-ens-faeeif.note: Covers 50%-80% of eligible costs depending on path; competitive scoring; applicant must be the project end user.

ns-greenshoots.note: Cumulative sales under $1M, TRL 4+, founders own 51%+ and work full-time; previous recipients ineligible.

ns-innovation-equity-tax-credit.note: Investee must be a CCPC with head office in Nova Scotia and under $15M in assets; credit goes to investors.

ns-invest-ns-accelerate.note: Cumulative revenue under $1M and under $250K equity raised; founders own 51%+ and work full-time; one-time only.

ns-market-entry-development-program.note: Open to export-ready businesses in all four Atlantic provinces; company contributes $1,250 or $2,500.

ns-scap-market-opportunities-diversifica.note: Farms and agri-businesses need $30,000+ eligible income; non-profit agricultural associations also eligible.

ns-capital-investment-tax-credit.note: Project must be approved before claiming; qualified property rules are in provincial legislation.

ns-film-television-production-incentive-.note: Apply before principal photography; minimum Nova Scotia spend $25,000; $287.50 application fee.

ns-research-development-tax-credit.note: Claimed with the corporate tax return on SR&ED performed in Nova Scotia.

ns-scap-on-farm-resiliency.note: Farms need $30,000+ eligible gross commodity income (Mi'kmaq farming and community pastures follow separate criteria).

ns-scap-on-farm-water-management.note: Farms need $30,000+ eligible gross commodity income (Mi'kmaq farming and community pastures follow separate criteria).

ns-invest-ns-payroll-rebate.note: Project must create at least 20 new FTE jobs in Nova Scotia paying above the regional average salary.

ns-scap-planning-new-opportunities.note: Farms and agri-businesses need $30,000+ eligible income; non-profit agricultural associations also eligible.

ns-plant-your-roots.note: Beginning farmers (under 5 years, under $30,000 farm revenue) or first-time buyers of a commercial farm; apply within 6 months of accepting the loan.

ns-start-hiring-incentive.note: Must be approved before hiring; hire must be an unemployed or under-employed Nova Scotian.

ns-ens-small-business-energy-solutions.note: Annual electricity use under 600,000 kWh; retrofit projects only; pre-approval before purchase.

ns-ens-smart-synergy.note: Nova Scotia Power account holders on rate codes 10-12 or 21-23 with 15-minute interval metering; 2026-27 enrolment closed.

ns-scap-technology-adoption.note: Farms and agri-businesses need $30,000+ eligible income (Mi'kmaq farming follows separate criteria).

ns-wipsi.note: Applicant must operate in or support a provincial priority sector.

nu-fisheries-development-diversification.note: Published policy expired August 31, 2015; confirm current terms with Nunavut EDT.

nu-nbcc-loans.note: NBCC generally prefers facilities over $150,000; smaller needs go to community futures organizations.

nu-ndc-equity-investment.note: Minimum $75,000 investment; co-investment from lenders and shareholders is required.

nu-strategic-investments-business-fund.note: Must qualify as a Nunavut Business under NNI; policy schedule sets $50,000-$250,000 and needs arm's-length financing.

on-co-operative-education-tax-credit.note: Hire a student from an eligible Ontario co-op program; 25% rate if payroll is $600,000 or more.

on-expanded-ontario-made-manufacturing-i.note: Only for corporations that are NOT Canadian-controlled private corporations (e.g. public or foreign-controlled).

on-ontario-creates-global-market-develop.note: Canadian-owned book publisher with 6+ Canadian-authored titles in print; non-profits only with a strong business case.

on-ontario-book-publishing-tax-credit.note: Canadian-controlled book publisher that published at least two books in the previous year.

on-ontario-business-research-institute-t.note: Research must be contracted to an eligible Ontario research institute the company is not connected to.

on-ontario-computer-animation-special-ef.note: More than $25,000 of eligible Ontario labour per production is required.

on-ontario-creates-ip-fund-interactive.note: Canadian-controlled games/XR studio with a senior owner or employee with 3+ years industry experience; proj_min derived from $15,000 minimum at 50%.

on-ontario-film-television-tax-credit.note: Canadian-controlled production company; producer must have been an Ontario resident for two years.

on-ontario-innovation-tax-credit.note: Must qualify for the federal SR&ED credit; limit phases out at prior-year taxable income of $500,000-$800,000.

on-ontario-interactive-digital-media-tax.note: 35% for fee-for-service work; partnerships and tax-exempt corporations are not eligible.

on-ontario-made-manufacturing-investment.note: Canadian-controlled private corporations only; non-CCPCs use the Expanded OMMITC.

on-ontario-production-services-tax-credi.note: Budget must exceed $1 million for features or $100,000-$200,000 per episode for series; cannot be combined with OFTTC.

on-ontario-research-development-tax-cred.note: Non-refundable; only useful to corporations with Ontario tax payable.

on-regional-opportunities-investment-tax.note: Investment must be in a designated Northern, Eastern or Southwestern Ontario region; expenditures must be incurred by December 31, 2026.

on-save-on-energy-energy-performance.note: Requires 12 months of hourly interval meter data and a commitment to 5% whole-facility savings.

on-save-on-energy-peak-performance.note: Class B customers only; facilities under 500 kW of demand response must join through an aggregator.

on-save-on-energy-retrofit.note: Pre-project approval required; lessees need the owner's consent.

on-starter-company-plus.note: Owner must be 18+, an Ontario resident and not a full-time student; contribute at least 25% of the grant.

on-summer-company.note: Students aged 15-29 returning to school; cannot already be running a business.

pe-efficiencypei-business-energy-rebates.note: Existing non-residential building occupied at least 6 months; new construction not eligible.

pe-capital-acquisition-assistance.note: Must produce mainly for export in an Innovation PEI strategic sector.

pe-employ-pei.note: Subsidy capped at $12.50/hour for up to 20 weeks; approval needed before the hire starts.

pe-export-trade-assistance.note: Strategic-sector exporters only; retail and consumer services are excluded.

pe-food-product-development-assistance.note: Must be a PEI food development, manufacturing or processing business.

pe-graduate-mentorship-program.note: Subsidy capped at $12.50/hour for up to 52 weeks; hire must have graduated within 5 years.

pe-innovation-fund.note: Exporting strategic-sector business; product must be at TRL 6-9.

pe-marketing-assistance.note: Must produce mainly for export in an Innovation PEI strategic sector.

pe-pei-labour-rebate.note: New full-time export-related jobs paying at least $35,000 held by PEI residents.

pe-rental-incentive-assistance.note: Strategic-sector exporters only; retail and consumer services are excluded.

pe-small-business-assistance.note: Business must be the owner's main income or employ someone; fishers, farmers, realty and financial firms excluded.

pe-small-business-investment-grant.note: Business must be the owner's main income or employ someone; fishers, farmers, realty and financial firms excluded.

pe-efficiencypei-strategic-energy-soluti.note: Project must be approved before purchase or installation.

pe-strategic-improvement-assistance.note: Must produce mainly for export in an Innovation PEI strategic sector.

pe-workplace-skills-training.note: Apply at least two weeks before training starts.

qc-multimedia-titles-tax-credit.note: Needs an Investissement Québec initial certificate per title, then an annual certificate.

qc-film-tv-production-tax-credit.note: Credit is 32% of eligible labour (labour capped at 65% of production costs); needs a SODEC certificate; Québec-resident control.

qc-film-production-services-tax-credit.note: Corporation providing production services in Québec; SODEC certificate required.

qc-depart-regional-entrepreneurship.note: Only businesses with an establishment in a targeted MRC (low-vitality MRCs, Gaspésie, etc.); proj_min derived from $15,000 minimum grant at 60%.

qc-fonds-impulsion.note: Pre-seed/seed startups with a lead investor, referred by an IQ partner incubator or accelerator.

qc-iq-productivity-loan.note: Minimum project is $250,000 for regular businesses ($25,000 for co-ops/NPOs); finance, legal, accounting and crypto excluded.

qc-iq-tax-credit-financing.note: Minimum loan $50,000 for SR&ED credits, $20,000 for other refundable credits; must have credits receivable.

qc-prime-vert-volet-1.note: Agricultural operations and CUMAs only; 50-70% by practice, +15% for young farmers and CUMAs.

qc-hydro-quebec-solutions-efficaces.note: Must be a Hydro-Québec (or eligible off-grid/municipal/co-op grid) customer; small businesses on rate G can get up to 90%.

qc-priime-immigrant-hiring.note: Employer must be registered with the REQ and hire a candidate holding a Services Québec PRIIME letter.

qc-padat-tourism-attractions.note: Must be legally constituted in Québec with a tourism attraction; proj_min derived from $150,000 minimum loan; deadline Dec 31, 2026.

qc-ipop-foreign-trained-professionals.note: Hire a foreign-trained professional referred via a professional order with a Services Québec letter; public bodies excluded.

qc-workforce-training-program.note: Amount set case by case by a Services Québec business advisor; contact the regional office first.

qc-programme-innovation-volet-1.note: Continuous intake suspended; only targeted calls for projects.

qc-programme-innovation-volet-2-collabor.note: Consortia of private businesses with universities/research centres; only during a specific call; program ends Mar 31, 2027.

qc-ecoperformance.note: Standard and large-industrial implementation streams are for cap-and-trade (SPEDE) emitters and voluntary participants; small users use the simplified streams.

qc-wage-subsidy-subvention-salariale.note: Candidate must be assessed by Services Québec and hold a wage subsidy letter; employer registered with the REQ.

qc-un-premier-emploi-pour-toi.note: Hire a 16-30 graduate (Apr 2025-Dec 2026 diploma) holding a Services Québec letter; NPOs get up to 100%, 16 weeks.

sk-creative-sask-book-publishing-product.note: Publisher must have produced 2+ commercial books in the past 12 months via 2+ channels.

sk-creative-sask-business-improvement-gr.note: Must be active in a Creative Saskatchewan sector; start-up costs ineligible; film and live performing arts paused 2026-27.

sk-creative-sask-digital-game-developmen.note: Game must be made available for commercial sale; commissioned projects ineligible.

sk-creative-sask-feature-film-tv-product.note: 30% Saskatchewan Stream / 25% Service Stream of SK spend; needs a market trigger; budgets over $250,000 need a single-purpose production company.

sk-creative-sask-film-tv-development.note: First/Final Draft need market development money of 10%+ of budget; Slate needs prior commercially distributed content.

sk-scap-livestock-facility-emissions.note: Closed to new applications; permitted hog/sheep barns with 300+ animal units indoors; rebate max $36 per animal unit.

sk-manufacturing-processing-tax-incentiv.note: For manufacturing and processing corporations; claimed on the T2 (Schedules 402/404).

sk-creative-sask-marketing-grant-major.note: Projects eligible for a production grant must apply there; film sector paused 2026-27.

sk-creative-sask-marketing-grant-micro.note: One Micro grant per applicant per fiscal year; film sector paused 2026-27.

sk-chemical-fertilizer-incentive.note: Synthetic fertilizer production (not potash-based) with $10M+ new capital; conditional approval applications by Dec 31, 2026.

sk-commercial-innovation-incentive.note: Corporation's only revenue must come from commercializing the qualifying IP.

sk-research-development-tax-credit.note: Refundable only for Saskatchewan CCPCs on the first $2M a year; credits capped at $1M a year.

sk-value-added-agriculture-incentive.note: Non-refundable credit against corporate income tax; $10M+ new capital that increases productive capacity.

sk-creative-sask-sound-recording.note: Recording and mixing must be done in Saskatchewan.

yt-economic-development-fund.note: Businesses must meet 3 of 4 Yukon presence conditions; capital costs funded at up to 50%.

yt-spark-tourism-microgrant.note: For new and emerging tourism entrepreneurs; not for established entities expanding existing offerings.

yt-staffing-up.note: Must employ at least one worker besides the owner; contact the program to build a plan first.

yt-sustainable-cap.note: Commercial stream needs 1+ year in Yukon and $15,000+ revenue or AgriStability; new entrants capped at $30,000.

yt-tourism-cooperative-marketing-fund.note: Both 2026-27 intakes have passed; amounts and cost share are in the program guidelines.
